explication: This repository provides a GitLab Model Context Protocol server: an MCP client invokes a selected tool, the server applies authentication and policy, performs GitLab API work, and returns a structured result. Its documented product surface includes project and collaboration management, CI/CD, wiki and release features, filtering/masking, multiple transports, and local or remote OAuth. The tree and sampled excerpts support the main entry, tool registry, OAuth proxy, masking and download subsystems; detailed links among unsampled feature handlers are intentionally omitted.
